title: Efficient computation of eddy-currents for nonlinear magnetic field problems
summary: Estimation of eddy-current losses in conducting non-laminated components of electrical devices requires expensive three-dimensional simulations. Various approximations are therefore used in practice to reduce the computational cost in the early design phase. We review some approaches and discuss their modelling assumptions and resulting approximations. In particular, we identify eddy-current reaction fields as a significant contribution that should be accounted for globally.
